name: Anaphexian Silencer (Prestige Classes)
body:
Anaphexian Silencers are special agents of the divine conscripted to wage a secret war in the deities’ name, eliminating those who would challenge the authority of divinity or invite alien powers to the world. In their service of divinity as a whole, these silencers are afforded many privileges which the deities deny their more conventional followers.

Hit Die: d10.

Requirements

To qualify to become an anaphexian silencer, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Deity: Must worship a god or pantheon of gods.
Skills: Bluff 5 ranks, Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks.
Special: Must be initiated by another agent of the Anaphexia or an outsider acting on behalf of a deity.
Class Skills

The anaphexian silencer’s class skills are Bluff (Cha), Climb (Str), Disguise (Cha), Knowledge (religion) (Int), Knowledge (planes) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Perception (Wis), Perform (any) (Cha), Sense Motive (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), Stealth (Dex), Survival (Wis), Swim (Wis), and Use Magic Device (Cha).

Skill Points at each Level: 6 + Int modifier.

Table 1-3: Anaphexian Silencer
Level	BAB	Fort Save	Reflex Save	Will Save	Features
1st	+1	+0	+1	+1	Anaphexia’s secrecy, pious enforcer +1
2nd	+2	+1	+1	+1	Aligned class (+1), anaphexia’s amnesty
3rd	+3	+1	+2	+2	Aligned class (+2), anaphexia’s syncretism
4th	+4	+1	+2	+2	Anaphexia’s carteblanche, pious enforcerr +2
5th	+5	+2	+3	+3	Aligned class (+3), cosmic disavowal
Class Features

The following are class features of an anaphexian silencer.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

An anaphexian silencer gains no additional weapon or armor proficiencies.

Anaphexia’s Secrecy (Su)

Starting at 1st level, for the purpose of divination effects and any ability or spell which could discern information they know or knew (including effects which target a corpse such as speak with dead), an anaphexian silencer is considered to know nothing about the Anaphexian organization, its goals, or its operations.

In addition, they gain a sacred or profane bonus (chosen at the time this ability is gained) on saving throws to resist divination effects equal to their anaphexian silencer level.

Pious Enforcer (Ex)

At 1st level, the anaphexian silencer is emboldened to strike down those who challenge the rule of divinity. They gain a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls against intelligent creatures who worship something that is not a deity or pantheon or who serve one of the Logi. This bonus applies against creatures who worship demigods, demon lords, great old ones, or other beings which grant spells but are not considered deities. This bonus increases to +2 at 4th level.

Aligned Class (Ex)

Starting at 2nd level, the anaphexian silencer chooses one base class they belonged to before gaining anaphexian silencer levels. The anaphexian silencer gains all the class features for this class, essentially adding each anaphexian silencer level at 2nd level, 3rd level, and 5th level to their aligned class to determine what class features they gain. The anaphexian silencer retains the Hit Dice, base attack bonus, saving throw bonuses, and skill ranks of the prestige class, but gains all other class features of their aligned class as well as those of the anaphexian silencer prestige class.

Anaphexia’s Amnesty (Su)

At 2nd level, the anaphexian silencer chooses an alignment that is different from their own. Once made, this choice cannot be changed. For the purposes of which gods grant them spells and abilities, which feats they may take, and which classes and prestige classes they may enter and use abilities from, the anaphexian silencer may choose to be treated as either their chosen alignment or their true alignment, whichever is more beneficial to them.

The anaphexian silencer may be treated as if they were both alignments simultaneously for the purpose of determining what options they may select and benefit from.

Anaphexia’s Syncretism (Su)

At 3rd level, an anaphexian silencer has become a potent enough tool that even deities of radically opposing ideologies are willing to use them cooperatively. Choose two deities. The anaphexian silencer may worship and gain the effects of feats and class abilities as if they were a worshiper of both deities (for example, if the anaphexian silencer takes the Deific Obedience feat, they gain the benefits associated with both gods they worship rather than just one).

This allows for combinations of archetypes or prestige classes tied to different deities (for example, a character with this ability may have levels in stargazer and rose warden, gaining all of the abilities of both).

The anaphexian silencer may select a second additional alignment with anaphexian amnesty.

Anaphexia’s Carteblanche (Su)

Starting at 4th level, when the anaphexian silencer targets a creature with an attack, spell, class ability, or other effect, they may treat that creature’s alignment as any alignment of the anaphexian silencer’s choice for the ability’s effects for 1 minute. A creature is allowed a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the anaphexian silencer’s character level + the highest of the anaphexian silencer’s Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier) to avoid having its effective alignment replaced in this way. A creature that succeeds at this saving throw cannot have its effective alignment shifted by the anaphexian silencer’s abilities for 24 hours.

Cosmic Disavowal (Su)

Starting at 5th level, higher powers conspire to hide the actions of an anaphexian silencer from existence. Whenever the anaphexian silencer kills a creature, the creature’s memories are erased, preventing its corpse or soul from divulging any substantive information when interrogated with spells or effects such as speak with dead. Additionally, if the creature is resurrected, it gains the amnesia greater severance.

Ex-anaphexian silencers

An anaphexian silencer who turns against their pantheon of gods or acts in a way which severely threatens their sovereignty over the planet loses all supernatural abilities associated with this prestige class. This will likely result in other silencers hunting the ex-anapehexian silencer down to ensure the organization’s secrecy.
